seo.title: Bistro Nine · Modern South Indian in Jayanagar
seo.description: Dosas, thalis and coastal plates from a small open kitchen on 9th Block, Jayanagar. Tables from 12 to 3:30 and 7 to 11.

props.headline: South Indian, slowly.
props.body: Batter fermented for two days, coconut grated to order and a thali that changes every Thursday. Lunch and dinner, closed Mondays.

props.heading: Six we're known for
props.intro: The full menu changes with the market. Tell us about allergies when you book.

items.title: Benne masala dosa
items.body: Davangere-style, crisp outside, soft inside, with white butter and potato palya.

items.title: Thursday thali
items.body: Eleven small bowls, red rice, two kinds of payasa. Unlimited refills.

items.title: Neer dosa and kori gassi
items.body: Lacy rice crêpes with a Mangalorean chicken curry.

items.title: Ragi mudde and saaru
items.body: Finger-millet dumplings with a peppery horse-gram broth.

items.title: Filter coffee
items.body: Made with Kaapi Corner's house decoction.

items.title: Warm gulab jamun
items.body: Two, with a scoop of tender-coconut ice cream.

props.heading: Worth the wait for a table

items.quote: The benne dosa is as good as Davangere, and the kori gassi made my Mangalorean father go quiet. High praise.
items.name: Shreya K.

items.quote: A thali that actually changes every week. We've been eleven Thursdays in a row.
items.name: Vikram and Leela

items.quote: Booked for my parents' anniversary; they put a little lamp on the table without being asked.
items.name: Arjun P.

props.heading: Book a table
props.body: We hold tables for fifteen minutes. Groups of eight or more, please call a day ahead.
